unrestricted_enchanting.config.title: Unrestricted Enchanting
unrestricted_enchanting.option.allowed.d: Forces the following enchantment IDs §7(e.g. §6minecraft:sharpness§7)§f to be §acompatible§f with the selected enchantment.
